GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 386.7 (29 Apr 47) CPC/GP
(SCAPIN - 1639)
APO 500
29 April 1947
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Release of Certain Securities Repatriated from Mukden.
1. Reference is made to:
a. C.L.O. 4541(RJ), 7 September 1946, subject, "Securities Deposited with General Liaison Office for Japanese Residents, Mukden."
b. Memorandum for Imperial Japanese Government, file AG 370.05 (7 May 46)GC, SCAPIN 927, Annex VI, 7 May 1946, subject, "Repatriation", from General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers.
c. Memorandum for Imperial Japanese Government, file AG 091.31 (12 Oct 45) ESS, SCAPIN 127, 12 October 1945, subject, "Supplemental Instructions Relating to Import and Export Controls", from General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers.
2. The Commanding General, Eighth Army, has been instructed to release subject securities, now stored at the Osaka Imperial Mint, to accredited representatives of the Imperial Japanese Government.
3. Upon receipt, the Imperial Japanese Government will thoroughly examine the securities. Terms of references 1b and 1c will be applied wherever appropriate. Specifically, the following actions will be taken by the Imperial Japanese Government:
a. All surrenderable instruments will be impounded.
b. Non-surrenderable property will be restored to the rightful owners.
c. The Imperial Japanese Government will submit to General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, within sixty (60) days after date of receipt of subject securities, a complete and accurate report of all properties impounded under terms of references 1b and 1c.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R.M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
